entities.summary: Tracy Lamont Moore is an American former professional basketball player who played in the National Basketball Association (NBA). A 6-foot-5-inch (1.96 m), 200-pound (91 kg) shooting guard, Moore played collegiately at the University of Tulsa. He was not drafted, but played with the Dallas Mavericks, Detroit Pistons and the Houston Rockets.
